forms.name: Petrified Shooter
forms.text:
Made using a fossil from the
Wycademy. The default Light
Bowgun for Bherna Hunters.

forms.name: Scholarly Shooter
forms.text:
The Petrified Shooter's final
form. A product of the Wycademy's
tireless monster research.

forms.name: Sophos Shooter
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Petrified Shooter</COL>.

forms.name: Kut-Ku Anger
forms.text:
Lightweight Bowgun made from
the head of a Yian Kut-Ku.
Explodes with hatred.

forms.name: Kut-Ku Counterattack
forms.text:
The Kut-Ku Anger's final form.
It holds its own in a fight against
even the toughest wyverns.

forms.name: Kut-Ku Rampage
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Kut-Ku Anger</COL>.

forms.name: Raven Do
forms.text:
A black Light Bowgun made of
Yian Garuga parts. Shots roar
out like a monster's cry.

forms.name: Wolf Do
forms.text:
Final form of the Raven Do.
Legend has it that its trigger grows
lighter in the face of its user's rage.

forms.name: Crow Do
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Raven Do</COL>.

forms.name: Vile Do
forms.text:
A Light Bowgun wielded by the
Garuga Corps's partisans. Many
great generals fell to them.

forms.name: Garuga Espringal
forms.text:
The final form of the Vile Do.
It houses the spirits of warriors
who hunt even in death.

forms.name: Occult Espringal
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Vile Do</COL>.

forms.name: Drowsy Eye
forms.text:
Forged with Malfestio materials,
this brilliant blue Bowgun catches
the eye of anyone passing it.

forms.name: Sleepy Eye
forms.text:
The Drowsy Eye's final form needs
only one successful hit to cast the
target into a realm of nightmares.

forms.name: Somnolescence
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Drowsy Eye</COL>.

forms.name: Tail String
forms.text:
A Light Bowgun covered in white
Blangonga fur. It envelops prey in
a chilling barrage.

forms.name: Tail Catapult
forms.text:
The Tail String's final form. Those
that stand against it are swallowed
in an avalanche-like flurry of shots.

forms.name: Tail Launcher
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Tail String</COL>.

forms.name: Sawgun
forms.text:
A sawed-off Bowgun made for
mobility. Like a Kecha Wacha,
it keeps prey on its toes.

forms.name: Buzzawcannon
forms.text:
The Sawgun's final iteration.
Embodying the spirit of a Kecha
Wacha, its mobility is high.

forms.name: Brushcutter Cannon
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Sawgun</COL>.

forms.name: Assault Conga
forms.text:
This assault weapon was forged
from the best Congalala parts. Its
shock-absorbing fur is fireproof.

forms.name: Combat Conga
forms.text:
The Assault Conga's final form.
Thanks to brilliant engineering, you
can use it in any environment.

forms.name: Raid Conga
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Assault Conga</COL>.

forms.name: Tail Blizzard
forms.text:
A weapon designed to protect the
people of snow country. It showers
foes in snow and bullets.

forms.name: Tail Avalanche
forms.text:
Final form of the Tail Blizzard.
It buries all who oppose it in a
layer of glistening white snow.

forms.name: Tail Tundra
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Tail Blizzard</COL>.

forms.name: Valkyrie Fire
forms.text:
A Bowgun made of Rathian parts.
Its flurry of shots feel like an
attack from the queen's talons.

forms.name: Valkyrie Blaze
forms.text:
The Valkyrie Fire's final form.
It cuts down any who would turn
against the will of the queen.

forms.name: Fierce Moss Green
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Valkyrie Fire</COL>.

forms.name: Blossomayhem
forms.text:
A glittering Bowgun from the
wyvern king. Foes have nowhere to
hide -- be it sun, moon, or sky.

forms.name: Prosperity
forms.text:
The Blossomayhem's final form.
The combined power of sun and
moon form a deadly ray of light.

forms.name: Mille Blossomayhem
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Blossomayhem</COL>.

forms.name: Dios Blaster
forms.text:
A Light Bowgun with a barrel
carved from Brachydios armor.
The slime has an eerie glow.

forms.name: Cobalt Blaster
forms.text:
The final upgrade for the Dios
Blaster. The use of Brachydios
slime gives it extra power.

forms.name: Meteoric Cobalt
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Dios Blaster</COL>.

forms.name: Demolition Gun
forms.text:
A weapon with the explosiveness
of a Brachydios. Light from the
chamber hints at massive power.

forms.name: Ballista Demolisher
forms.text:
Final iteration of the Demolition
Gun. Its muzzle gives off a brilliant
flash when firing its powerful blasts.

forms.name: Ballista Annihilator
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Demolition Gun</COL>.

forms.name: Lightbreak Gun
forms.text:
A Brachydios Light Bowgun whose
unprecedented blasts wed forge
tech with extensive research.

forms.name: Lightbreak Flash
forms.text:
The Lightbreak Gun's final form,
manifesting when destructive
technique is taken to its limit.

forms.name: Lightbreak Sunburst
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Lightbreak Gun</COL>.

forms.name: Obsidian Shooter
forms.text:
A weapon made from a beautiful
fossil. Its mighty blasts carry the
weight of history with them.

forms.name: Relic Debonia
forms.text:
The Obsidian Shooter's final
form. It features an ancient
power within its black casing.

forms.name: Ethereal Debonia
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Obsidian Shooter</COL>.

forms.name: Mythical Three-Horn
forms.text:
While built from ancient
instructions, its firing capabilities
exceed most modern weapons.

forms.name: Mythical Three-Evils
forms.text:
The Mythical Three-Horn's final
iteration. Modern technology has
restored its true power.

forms.name: Mythical Three-Legs
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Mythical Three-Horn</COL>.

forms.name: Blitz Bowgun
forms.text:
A Bowgun made from unusual
materials in response to
hard-core Gunner demand.

forms.name: Blitz Kirin
forms.text:
Final form of the Blitz Bowgun.
Channels the Kirin's electric
charge into its powerful shots.

forms.name: Blitz Kirin King
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Blitz Bowgun</COL>.

forms.name: Hunter's Rifle
forms.text:
A Bowgun with a large frame,
perfect for beginners. Simple,
yet also a full-featured weapon.

forms.name: Sniper Shot
forms.text:
The final form of the Hunter's
Rifle. Hunters have come to rely
upon its much improved damage.

forms.name: Sniper Ascension
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Hunter's Rifle</COL>.

forms.name: Khezu Syringe
forms.text:
A grotesque Bowgun that
resembles a Khezu head. Heals
allies with Recovery shots.

forms.name: Khezu Hypo
forms.text:
The strange final form of the
Khezu Syringe. It possesses both
healing and destructive traits.

forms.name: Hyodermic Miracle
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Khezu Syringe</COL>.

forms.name: Quill Burst
forms.text:
A Bowgun made for precision
aiming. Its tri-color scales make
it an attractive weapon as well.

forms.name: Plume Burst
forms.text:
The final form of the Quill Burst.
Further enhanced for precision
aiming, nothing escapes its sight.

forms.name: Pinion Burst
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Quill Burst</COL>.

forms.name: Shotgun (White)
forms.text:
A beautiful Light Bowgun that
coolly showers its foes with
a barrage of ice bullets.

forms.name: Bullet Rain (White)
forms.text:
The final form of the Shotgun
(White). Its bullets fall on its
enemies like a relentless rain.

forms.name: Bullet Storm (White)
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Shotgun (White)</COL>.

forms.name: Shotgun (Viper)
Bullet Rain (Viper)
forms.text:
The Shotgun (Viper)'s final form.
It has enhanced performance, and
can fire Pellet and Poison ammo.

forms.name: Bullet Storm (Viper)
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Shotgun (Viper)</COL>.

forms.name: Shotgun (Azure)
forms.text:
Utilizes a straight frame
to allow the use of Pellet
shots.

forms.name: Bullet Rain (Azure)
forms.text:
The linear barrel of the final
form of the Shotgun (Azure) fires
straight and true. Loved by experts.

forms.name: Bullet Storm (Azure)
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Shotgun (Azure)</COL>.

forms.name: Shotgun (Green)
forms.text:
A weapon that has been
upgraded to use Paralysis
shots.

forms.name: Bullet Rain (Green)
forms.text:
The final form of the Shotgun
(Green), its Paralysis ammo lets
hunters take on large monsters solo.

forms.name: Bullet Storm (Green)
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Shotgun (Green)</COL>.

forms.name: Shotgun (Blood)
forms.text:
A blood-colored Light
Bowgun upgraded to make
effective use of Pellet shots.

forms.name: Bullet Rain (Blood)
forms.text:
The final form of the Shotgun
(Blood) is as good for support fire
as it is for mowing down foes.

forms.name: Bullet Storm (Blood)
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Shotgun (Blood)</COL>.

forms.name: Scale Tornado
forms.text:
A Bowgun with a spiral barrel.
Its blasts can bore through solid
rock, much like an Uroktor.

forms.name: Uroktor Vortex
forms.text:
This final upgrade takes the
Scale Tornado's spiral to its limit
to increase range and power.

forms.name: Uroktor Tempest
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Scale Tornado</COL>.

forms.name: Barro Barrel
forms.text:
A Light Bowgun made from Barroth
shell. Shots have great power, but
aim is somewhat questionable.

forms.name: Barro Blaster
forms.text:
The Barro Barrel's final form.
Its powerful bullets can penetrate
the thickest steel walls.

forms.name: Barrozooka
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Barro Barrel</COL>.

forms.name: Usurper's Crime
forms.text:
A Bowgun with the instincts of
a monarch. Echoing shots mark
the start of the royal hunt.

forms.name: Despot's Wildfire
forms.text:
A king's hunt is never done, not
'til he's caught all of creation.
Usurper's Crime's final form.

forms.name: Oppressor's Rift
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Usurper's Crime</COL>.

forms.name: Rasasa Bowgun
forms.text:
A Seregios Light Bowgun. Evading
with the weapon drawn auto-loads
one round of the selected ammo.

forms.name: Rebel Stopper
forms.text:
The Rasasa Bowgun's final form.
Its shots are guaranteed to end
any rebellion that may arise.

forms.name: No Resistance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Rasasa Bowgun</COL>.

forms.name: Seditious Shot
forms.text:
A ruinous wind. Evading
with the weapon out auto-loads
one round of the selected ammo.

forms.name: Vayu Sedition
forms.text:
The final form of the Seditious
Shot. Its shots rain down like
the seeds of fiery rebellion.

forms.name: Sedition Sniper
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Seditious Shot</COL>.

forms.name: Leader's Thunder
forms.text:
A Bowgun with the instincts of
a monarch. Echoing shots mark
the start of the royal hunt.

forms.name: Despot's Wedge
forms.text:
The Leader's Thunder's final form.
It carries the souls of the best
hunters. Escape is futile.

forms.name: Orcus Barqus
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Leader's Thunder</COL>.

forms.name: Mandible Blaster
forms.text:
A Bowgun with a gaping maw
like a Zamtrios. Its shots chase
prey to the ends of the earth.

forms.name: Jawbreaker
forms.text:
The Mandible Blaster's final form.
It opens its mouth until it nearly
splits in order to devour its prey.

forms.name: Jowlcrusher
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Mandible Blaster</COL>.

forms.name: Durambarrel
forms.text:
Light Bowgun made from Duramboros
parts. Make sure to fire precisely
rather than recklessly.

forms.name: Aldebaran Dreadgun
forms.text:
The Durambarrel's final
iteration. Sturdy as a Duramboros,
it deals top-class damage.

forms.name: Aldebaran Dreadblast
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Durambarrel</COL>.

forms.name: Cross Bowgun
forms.text:
The original bone-based Bowgun. A
good weapon for novices, it is quite
effective against smaller monsters.

forms.name: Cross Blitz
forms.text:
The Cross Bowgun's final form.
Everything about it has been
revised for added performance.

forms.name: Cross Blitzkrieg
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Cross Bowgun</COL>.

forms.name: Striped Shell
forms.text:
A Bowgun made of Hermitaur
parts. It's extremely durable, with
stripes in brilliant red and white.

forms.name: Daimyo Pincer
forms.text:
Final form of the Striped Shell.
The victorious blast it fires can
kick off any celebration.

forms.name: Daimyo Crusher
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Striped Shell</COL>.

forms.name: Lobster Gun
forms.text:
A Bowgun made from the shell
of a King Lobster. It can rapidly
fire Water ammo at its target.

forms.name: King Lobster Gun
forms.text:
The final form of the Lobster
Gun, its increased power strikes
foes with the force of a waterfall.

forms.name: Royal Lobster Gun
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Lobster Gun</COL>.

forms.name: Maelstrom
forms.text:
A Light Bowgun that prioritizes
versatility over sheer force. It can
also rapid fire Sleep ammo.

forms.name: Nebula Storm
forms.text:
The final form of the Maelstrom.
The power within it crushes foes
with a waterfall's strength.

forms.name: Plesioth Drencher
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Maelstrom</COL>.

forms.name: Royal Launcher
forms.text:
A Light Bowgun made from spongy
materials. Designed to work quite
well with Water shots.

forms.name: Royal Torrent
forms.text:
The final evolution of the
Royal Launcher, the volleys it fires
can put a swift end to any target.

forms.name: Royal Tempest
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Royal Launcher</COL>.

forms.name: Hidden Eye
forms.text:
An ebon Bowgun, black as night.
Twin barrels glint in the dark
like a predator's eyes.

forms.name: Night Owl
forms.text:
The final form of the Hidden Eye.
It is the perfect weapon for hunting
prey within the darkness of night.

forms.name: Avidya Eye
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Hidden Eye</COL>.

forms.name: Yakt Shooter
forms.text:
A Light Bowgun that contains the
soul of a dragon. It can awaken
a hunter's latent powers.

forms.name: Wyvern Chaser
forms.text:
The final upgrade for the Yakt
Shooter. A dragon's soul resides
within, waiting for new victims.

forms.name: Dark Hunter
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Yakt Shooter</COL>.

forms.name: Tigrex Tank
forms.text:
An explosive Light Bowgun made of
Tigrex parts. Its damage output
makes it a monster in combat.

forms.name: Tigrex Wargun
forms.text:
The Tigrex Tank's final form, it is
made from sturdy Tigrex parts and
features experimental technology.

forms.name: Great Tigrex Wargun
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Tigrex Tank</COL>.

forms.name: Shell Shooter
forms.text:
Uses Seltas parts for a
smooth firing mechanism that
pumps bullets out quickly.

forms.name: Insect Vulcan
forms.text:
The final iteration of the Shell
Shooter features enhanced
rotation and firing capabilities.

forms.name: Hornet's Nest
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Shell Shooter</COL>.

forms.name: Machine Strafer
forms.text:
A Light Bowgun using Seltas Queen
materials to maximize rotation
and make quick work of enemies.

forms.name: Battalion Strafer
forms.text:
The Machine Strafer's final form.
Countless rotation improvements
give it immense power.

forms.name: Legion Strafer
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Machine Strafer</COL>.

forms.name: Grenade Launcher
forms.text:
Forged with Basarios materials, this
weapon is robust and sturdy, but
very heavy.

forms.name: Grenade Revolver
forms.text:
The Grenade Launcher's final form
has firepower upgraded to the limit.
Its bullet storm tears prey to pieces.

forms.name: Volarevolver
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Grenade Launcher</COL>.

forms.name: Titan Launcher
forms.text:
Forged with Gravios materials, its
raw attack power and versatility
make it a prized possession.

forms.name: Titan Panzer
forms.text:
The Titan Grande's final form. Its
stopping power and handling
have been upgraded to the max.

forms.name: Titan Bombardier
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Titan Launcher</COL>.

forms.name: Blizzard Cannon
forms.text:
A bowgun with a Barioth's might.
This vessel of the snow gods uses
icy bullets to summon blizzards.

forms.name: Blizzard Volley
forms.text:
The Blizzard Cannon's final form.
Its cold-resistant design allows for
the Rapid Fire of Freeze ammo.

forms.name: Tabula Blizzara
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Blizzard Cannon</COL>.

forms.name: Rathling Gun
forms.text:
A Bowgun that can fire Flaming
shots which roast foes like fire
from the King of the Skies.

forms.name: Rathling Phoenix
forms.text:
The Rathling Gun's final form.
Foes tremble before it, until
they're nothing but carcasses.

forms.name: Eternal Rathling Phoenix
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Rathling Gun</COL>.

forms.name: Thundacrus
forms.text:
A Light Bowgun made of Lagiacrus
parts. Its majestic barrel can
fire high voltage electricity.

forms.name: Thundacrus Rex
forms.text:
The Thundacrus's final evolution.
Electrical power courses through it,
making it the epitome of fear itself.

forms.name: Spinothundacrus
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Thundacrus</COL>.

forms.name: Desert Storm
forms.text:
A Light Bowgun that focuses on
fast reload speeds. Allows for
high mobility in battle.

forms.name: Desert Tempest
forms.text:
The Desert Storm's final form.
Its cartridge chamber is fortified,
pushing its damage to the limit.

forms.name: Desert Torrent
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Desert Storm</COL>.

forms.name: Lava Storm
forms.text:
Its slender barrel is a thing of
beauty. The design of this Bowgun
allows for various ammo types.

forms.name: Magma Storm
forms.text:
The final form of the Lava Storm.
It can fire various ammo types
and is loved by snipers.

forms.name: Scoria Storm
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Lava Storm</COL>.

forms.name: Yukumo Light Bowgun
forms.text:
A Light Bowgun made from iron
and wood from Yukumo. Its sturdy
design is good for tough hunts.

forms.name: Yukumo Shooter
forms.text:
The final form of the Yukumo Light
Bowgun. It is capable of dealing
with any problems its hunters face.

forms.name: Hot Spring Shooter
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Yukumo Light Bowgun</COL>.

forms.name: Yukumo Pureshot
forms.text:
The true form of the Yukumo Light
Bowgun. Hunters have come to rely
on its precision and craftsmanship.

forms.name: Yukumo Spiritshot
forms.text:
The Yukumo Pureshot's final form.
Its muzzle flashes brightly as it rains
destruction down on its enemies.

forms.name: Yukumo Aurashot
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Yukumo Pureshot</COL>.

forms.name: Felyne Ragdoll
forms.text:
A doll made in the image of a Felyne.
It is a deadly Light Bowgun that can
rapidly fire elemental bullets.

forms.name: Felyne Helldoll
forms.text:
Final form of the Felyne Ragdoll.
It is cute to behold, but its enemies
quickly learn how deadly it really is.

forms.name: Felyne Heavendoll
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Felyne Ragdoll</COL>.

forms.name: Melynx Ragdoll
forms.text:
A doll made in the image of a Melynx.
It is a deadly Light Bowgun that can
rapidly fire elemental bullets.

forms.name: Melynx Helldoll
forms.text:
The Melynx Ragdoll's final form.
It looks cute until it unleashes
sheer terror on the unsuspecting.

forms.name: Melynx Heavendoll
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Melynx Ragdoll</COL>.

forms.name: Kettleblower
forms.text:
A kettle that houses a Felyne that
loves blowguns. It loves to help on
a hunt, but is scared of wyverns.

forms.name: Kettleblower Deluxe
forms.text:
The Kettleblower's final form,
housing a Felyne blowgun expert.
It demands Felvine as payment.

forms.name: Master Kettleblower
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Kettleblower</COL>.

forms.name: Black Belt Bowgun
forms.text:
The blood and tears shed in the
arena given physical form. Only
for those who know how to fight.

forms.name: Shihan Bowgun
forms.text:
The final upgrade for the Black
Belt Bowgun. The reminders of
tragic battles lie within it.

forms.name: Grandmaster Bowgun
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Black Belt Bowgun</COL>.

forms.name: Fiossidare
forms.text:
Its design is based on the various
flowers that bloom each season.
The petals change its functionality.

forms.name: Sparkling Blossom
forms.text:
The Fiossidare's final form.
Its ring of flowers scatter an
endless shower of sparks.

forms.name: Floral Elegance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Fiossidare</COL>.

forms.name: Beast Sniper
forms.text:
A Bowgun made from insects
that glitters in the sunlight. Its
shots grants insects' wishes.

forms.name: Beast Blaster
forms.text:
The Beast Sniper's final form.
It carries the hopes and dreams of
countless insects with each blast!

forms.name: Beast Sharpshooter
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Beast Sniper</COL>.

forms.name: Springnight Shot
forms.text:
An exquisite weapon, colored
after a Springnight Carp. It also
features the latest technology.

forms.name: Springnight Spawn
forms.text:
The Springnight Shot's final
form. It seems to strengthen in
response to its user's mastery.

forms.name: Springnight Finshot
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Springnight Shot</COL>.

forms.name: Airship Gun
forms.text:
Fight on with courage!
A Light Bowgun made from the
equipment aboard an airship.

forms.name: Airship Cannon
forms.text:
The Airship Gun's final form.
This weapon can bring down
an airship with relative ease.

forms.name: Airship Blaster
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Airship Gun</COL>.

forms.name: Veiled Bell
forms.text:
Ringing the golden bell creates
a sound that resonates far and
wide, heading for all that hear it.

forms.name: High Plains Bell
forms.text:
The Veiled Bell's final upgrade.
It rings with a sound clear and true,
aiding hunters in their fight.

forms.name: Reverb Bell
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Veiled Bell</COL>.

forms.name: Eldra Musket
forms.text:
Made from relics found by the
Meownster Hunters. Its slender
design is breathtaking.

forms.name: Lost Musket
forms.text:
The Eldra Musket's final form.
Both beautiful and functional,
it is a true work of art.

forms.name: Lost Xanadu
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Eldra Musket</COL>.

forms.name: Desolate Mist
forms.text:
A weapon used by a warrior who
brought peace to a chaotic land.
It scatters enemies like the fog.

forms.name: Nifl Mist
forms.text:
The Desolate Mist's final form.
This weapon knows not the fog's
evanescence, only its potency.

forms.name: Encroaching Mist
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Desolate Mist</COL>.

forms.name: Astalos Gun
forms.text:
A Bowgun made from Astalos
parts, its strikes crash into
prey like lightning from above.

forms.name: Astalos Shocker
forms.text:
The Astalos Gun's final form.
Victims scream in vain as their
very essence is swept away.

forms.name: Astalos Flashblaster
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Astalos Gun</COL>.

forms.name: Giant's Blaster
forms.text:
A Light Bowgun said to have been
used by an ancient warrior. Its roar
can lay waste to entire forests.

forms.name: Colossus's Blaster
forms.text:
The Giant's Blaster's final form.
Said to have been used against an
evil god that attacked the mountains.

forms.name: Behemoth's Blaster
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Giant's Blaster</COL>.

forms.name: Burning Answer
forms.text:
A Bowgun that has harnessed
the scorching flames that come
from the throat of a Glavenus.

forms.name: Glavenus Shot
forms.text:
The final evolution of the Burning
Answer. It is designed to carpet
the earth in crimson flames.

forms.name: Glavenus Shotanova
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Burning Answer</COL>.

forms.name: Fäulnisschleuder
forms.text:
A rare weapon whose bullets
bite into prey with all the
hatred of a Gore Magala.

forms.name: Wahnschleuder
forms.text:
The Fäulnisschleuder's final form.
A devilish weapon, its bullets
contain the essence of evil.

forms.name: Teufelsschleuder
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Fäulnisschleuder</COL>.

forms.name: La Lumière
forms.text:
A rare weapon whose bullets
promise a victory as sublime
as the Shagaru Magala.

forms.name: Le Condamnateur
forms.text:
The final upgrade for La Lumière.
It spreads the sheer joy of the
Shagaru Magala with the world.

forms.name: La Vertu
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>La Lumière</COL>.

forms.name: Blessed Lamp
forms.text:
Made from Chameleos into a
unique Light Bowgun.
Rubbing it has no effect.

forms.name: Cursed Lamp
forms.text:
The Blessed Lamp's final form.
The evil spirit once imprisoned
within it lent it mysterious powers.

forms.name: Genie's Lamp
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Blessed Lamp</COL>.

forms.name: Skeletal Bowgun
forms.text:
A Bowgun that emits an intense
pain-inducing light once its shell
is opened.

forms.name: Mysterious Husk
forms.text:
The Skeletal Bowgun's final form. Its
light gives rise to a sense of wonder
as it ushers in an empty void.

forms.name: Acubens Shooter
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Skeletal Bowgun</COL>.

forms.name: Polarstar Shooter
forms.text:
A Bowgun imbued with the
cosmos. It fires with the force
of a streaking comet.

forms.name: Wondrous Star
forms.text:
The Polarstar Shooter's final
form. Enemies of the stars fall
before its resplendence.

forms.name: Blast of the North Star
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Polarstar Shooter</COL>.

forms.name: Black Parasol
forms.text:
A jet black umbrella with an
assassin's thirst for death.
Said to hold a dark power.

forms.name: Onyx Parasol
forms.text:
The final form of the Black
Parasol, the evil within it can
summon a murderous rain.

forms.name: Fatalis Parasol
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Black Parasol</COL>.

forms.name: Angel Parasol
forms.text:
Found in the possession of a
captured spy, the Guild has
denied any involvement.

forms.name: Elegant Parasol
forms.text:
The Angel Parasol's final form.
Despite its elegant
appearance, its force is sinister.

forms.name: Pearl Parasol
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Angel Parasol</COL>.

forms.name: Rajang Barrage
forms.text:
A tri-barreled Bowgun with
firepower that's completely
off the charts.

forms.name: Ten Thousand Volts
forms.text:
A Bowgun with the unparalleled
fighting spirit of a Rajang. The
Rajang Barrage's final upgrade.

forms.name: Ten Million Volts
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Rajang Barrage</COL>.

forms.name: Demonlord Blaster
forms.text:
A Light Bowgun with three barrels
held together by Rajang rage.
Resounds with peerless thunder.

forms.name: Demonlord Cannon
forms.text:
The Demonlord Blaster's final
form. Its shots ring forth across
the sky like pealing thunder.

forms.name: Demonlord Crasher
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Demonlord Blaster</COL>.

forms.name: Devil's Grin
forms.text:
A baleful Bowgun said to
have been crafted in a
dark workshop.

forms.name: Devil's Madness
forms.text:
The final form of the Devil's Grin.
A pact struck with an evil force led
its original owner to sell his soul.

forms.name: Devil's Insanity
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Devil's Grin</COL>.

forms.name: Diregun "Dementia"
forms.text:
A Light Bowgun polished with
Deviljho blood. Its fangs pursue
foes even beyond the grave.

forms.name: Doomgun "Dementia"
forms.text:
The final form of the Diregun
"Dementia." It seeks to envelop
the world in death.

forms.name: Deathgun "Dementia"
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Diregun "Dementia"</COL>.

forms.name: Gourd Shot
forms.text:
A Bowgun converted from a souvenir
sold in a village near the Misty Peaks.
Makes a pleasant pop when fired.

forms.name: Crookneck Shot
forms.text:
The final upgrade of the Gourd
Shot, based on user feedback.
It's no ordinary souvenir.

forms.name: Calabash Shot
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Gourd Shot</COL>.

forms.name: Research Shooter
forms.text:
This Soaratorium weapon has a
convenient lantern built in, to keep
visibility on those night shifts.

forms.name: Discovery Shooter
forms.text:
The Research Shooter's final form.
Researchers say it literally shines
a light on difficult problems.

forms.name: Authority Illuminator
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Research Shooter</COL>.

forms.name: Arm Cannon
forms.text:
The trusted weapon of a famed
bounty hunter who protects
the peace of the galaxy.

forms.name: Arm Cannon X
forms.text:
The Arm Cannon's final form.
The evil of the galaxy stands
no chance against its blasts.

forms.name: Arm Cannon XX
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of
the <COL FF0000FF>Arm Cannon</COL>.

forms.name: Icesteel Wasp
forms.text:
A Kushala Daora Light Bowgun
that hums like beating wings and
brings icy rain down on foes.

forms.name: Daora's Hornet
forms.text:
The final form of the Icesteel
Wasp. Its fierce blasts freeze
the very souls of its targets.

forms.name: Daora's Yellowjacket
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Icesteel Wasp</COL>.

forms.name: Silver Spartacus
forms.text:
A Bowgun with the majesty of a
Silver Rathalos. Varied features
allow it to handle any situation.

forms.name: Silver Semi-Auto
forms.text:
Final form of the Silver
Spartacus. Any that see its
silvery sun will never forget it.

forms.name: Silver Asgard
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Silver Spartacus</COL>.

forms.name: Gold Valkyrie
forms.text:
A Bowgun made from the Gold
Rathian. Its moonlight lures the
souls of prey to the afterlife.

forms.name: Gold Semi-Auto
forms.text:
The Gold Valkyrie's final form.
Any that look upon the golden moon
lose their minds and their lives.

forms.name: Gold Ullr
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Gold Valkyrie</COL>.

forms.name: Ukanlos Frost Bow
forms.text:
The embodiment of the white
god's sixth power: its breath,
which can freeze the world.

forms.name: Ukanlos Skyshatterer
forms.text:
The Ukanlos Frost Bow's final
form. With its chilling breath, the
snow god coated the land in ice.

forms.name: Ukanlos Cosmosbreaker
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ukanlos Frost Bow</COL>.

forms.name: Wicked Needle
forms.text:
A Light Bowgun from heaven's
summit. Each shot fired is like a
commandment from the gods.

forms.name: Needlestorm
forms.text:
The Wicked Needle's final form.
It can bring peace to the darkness
of men's souls.

forms.name: Needle Phalanx
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Wicked Needle</COL>.

forms.name: Silverwing Shooter
forms.text:
A glistening silver Bowgun. Like
the Argent Comet, its bullets rain
down like a meteor shower.

forms.name: Dragonstar Hotek
forms.text:
The Silverwing Shooter's final form.
"Fear me, the riftmaker; my bullets
tear the fabric of space asunder."

forms.name: Magnastar Lubos
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Silverwing Shooter</COL>.

forms.name: Elder Shooter
forms.text:
A Soaratorium Light Bowgun
for hunters breaking new ground.
Marvellous firing power.

forms.name: Sage Shooter
forms.text:
The Elder Shooter's final form.
Engineered to accurately pinpoint
a target's vital points.

forms.name: Philosopher Shooter
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Elder Shooter</COL>.

forms.name: Memento Barbas
forms.text:
This limited edition Light Bowgun
celebrates the Soaratorium's launch.
It's not a bad weapon either!

forms.name: Barbas Select
forms.text:
The Memento Barbas's final form.
You thought the first one was
exclusive? Then get a load of this!

forms.name: First Class
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Memento Barbas</COL>.

forms.name: Ace Bowgun
forms.text:
This Light Bowgun is favored by
goths everywhere for its fancy
design and muted palette.

forms.name: Loyal Ace Bowgun
forms.text:
Ace Bowgun's final form. Its
twisted design is used as inspiration
for honest, cutting poetry.

forms.name: The Gunner
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of
<COL FF0000FF>Ace Bowgun</COL>.

forms.name: Bulletfox
forms.text:
A custom Famitsu bowgun.
Sleek and golden, its shots
can preempt the future.

forms.name: Foxbow Flash
forms.text:
The Bulletfox's final
form. Pinpoints targets
in the blink of an eye.

forms.name: Foxbow Authority
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Bulletfox</COL>.

forms.name: Beschwörung/Oracle
forms.text:
A Light Bowgun whose Affinity
changes when its wielder
overcomes the Frenzy.

forms.name: Vergebung/Peine
forms.text:
The Beschwörung/Oracle's final
form. Shows its true potential only to
those who'd atone for their sins.

forms.name: Fäulnis/Vertu
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Beschwörung/Oracle</COL>.

forms.name: Goldshooter
forms.text:
Golden relic of a lost civilization.
The inscription tells of a tome which
imparts absolute truth.

forms.name: Inscribed Djehuty
forms.text:
The Goldshooter's final form.
Having imparted wisdom upon
leaders, it is now reborn.

forms.name: Trismegistus
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Goldshooter</COL>.

forms.name: Fatalis Pit
forms.text:
This weapon, fashioned after the
wing of the accursed Fatalis, uses
its bearer's soul with each shot.

forms.name: Fatalis Depths
forms.text:
The Fatalis Pit's final form.
It seduces those who crave power
and asserts total control over them.

forms.name: Fatalis Abyss
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Fatalis Pit</COL>.

forms.name: Ruiner Recurve
forms.text:
This blood-stained weapon is said to
imbue the truly corrupt with power
to commit wanton destruction.

forms.name: True Ruiner Recurve
forms.text:
The Ruiner Recurve's final form.
Its seductive power lures its wielder
ever closer to despair and ruin.

forms.name: Absolute Ruiner Recurve
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ruiner Recurve</COL>.

forms.name: Ancient Bowgun
forms.text:
Imbued with old Fatalis protection,
this weapon's pure white bullets
grant an indomitable will.

forms.name: Absolute Bowgun
forms.text:
The Ancient Bowgun's final form.
Blessed by an old Fatalis, its
bullets grant unwavering faith.

forms.name: Absolution Bowgun
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ancient Bowgun</COL>.

forms.name: Rathian Fire
forms.text:
A Light Bowgun made from
Dreadqueen parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Flaming Rose
forms.text:
The Rathian Fire's final iteration.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Dreadqueen Rathian.

forms.name: Blazing Rose
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Rathian Fire</COL>!

forms.name: Squall's Gaze
forms.text:
A Light Bowgun made from
Silverwind parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Daybreak's Gaze
forms.text:
The Squall's Gaze's final iteration.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Silverwind Nargacuga.

forms.name: Hurricane's Gaze
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Squall's Gaze</COL>!

forms.name: Wicked Do
forms.text:
A Light Bowgun made from
Deadeye parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Deadeye Hunter
forms.text:
The Wicked Do's final iteration.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Deadeye Yian Garuga.

forms.name: Apocalypse Hunter
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Wicked Do</COL>!

forms.name: Dreadking Blaster
forms.text:
A Light Bowgun made from
Dreadking parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Dreadking's Bane
forms.text:
The Dreadking Blaster's final
form. Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Dreadking Rathalos.

forms.name: Dreadking's Harness
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Dreadking Blaster</COL>!

forms.name: Thunder Lycan
forms.text:
A Light Bowgun made from
Thunderlord parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Thunderclaw
forms.text:
The Thunder Lycan's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Thunderlord Zinogre.

forms.name: Flashbang Thunderclaw
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Thunder Lycan</COL>!

forms.name: Rudra Shot
forms.text:
A Light Bowgun made from
Grimclaw parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Grimclaw Hunter
forms.text:
The Rudra Shot's final iteration.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Grimclaw Tigrex.

forms.name: Grimclaw's Grip
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Rudra Shot</COL>!

forms.name: Infernal Solution
forms.text:
A Light Bowgun made from
Hellblade parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Brimstone Blaster
forms.text:
The Infernal Solution's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Hellblade Glavenus.

forms.name: Combustion Supernova
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Infernal Solution</COL>!

forms.name: Cloaked Threat
forms.text:
A Light Bowgun made from
Nightcloak parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Cloaked Fear
forms.text:
The Cloaked Threat's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Nightcloak Malfestio.

forms.name: Cloaked Scourge
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Cloaked Threat</COL>!

forms.name: Dew on the Leaves
forms.text:
A Light Bowgun made from
Soulseer parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Autumn Shower
forms.text:
Dew on the Leaves's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Soulseer Mizutsune.

forms.name: Cardinal Deluge
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of
<COL FF0000FF>Dew on the Leaves</COL>!

forms.name: Boltreaver Shooter
forms.text:
A Light Bowgun made from
Boltreaver parts. Wielding it fills
the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Boltreaver Screech
forms.text:
The Boltreaver Shooter's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Boltreaver Astalos.

forms.name: Boltreaver Azurebolt
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Boltreaver Shooter</COL>!

forms.name: Elderfrost Shooter
forms.text:
A Light Bowgun made from
Elderfrost parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Elderfrost Blaster
forms.text:
The Elderfrost Shooter's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Elderfrost Gammoth.

forms.name: Elderfrost Barrage
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Elderfrost Shooter</COL>!

forms.name: Massacre Buster
forms.text:
A Light Bowgun made from
Bloodbath parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Massacre Barrage
forms.text:
The Massacre Buster's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Bloodbath Diablos.

forms.name: Kazusa
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Massacre Buster</COL>!

forms.name: Demon's Isle
forms.text:
A Light Bowgun with a design that
differs from those of the Guild.
It boasts exceptional performance.

forms.name: Demon's Island
forms.text:
The final form of the mysterious
Demon's Isle. It strikes its
prey with lightning speed.

forms.name: Demon's Archipelago
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Demon's Isle</COL>.

forms.name: God's Isle
forms.text:
A mysterious Bowgun unearthed
from the ancient past. Unlike
anything made by the Guild.

forms.name: God's Island
forms.text:
The final form of God's Isle.
Compares favorably to modern
weapons for firing capability.

forms.name: God's Archipelago
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>God's Isle</COL>.
